newsitem.title: USA: Folgers raises price for 13 oz can coffee.
newsitem.headline: Folgers raises price for 13 oz can coffee.

text.p: Procter & Gamble unit Folgers Coffee Co. said it will raise the list price on its standard 13-ounce can of ground regular and ground decaffeinated coffees by 30 cents due to higher prices of green coffee on the world's futures markets.
The increase, which is to take effect immediately, brings the price for a standard can of regular coffee to $3.36, and decaffeinated ground Folgers up to $4.06, the company said.

"The price of Folgers coffee generally reflects the price of green coffee sold on the commodity market," Folgers saids in a statement. "Green coffee prices have been rising since January, and have continued due to a number of factors including reduced crop estimates for the upcoming coffee harvest in Brazil, reduced availability of coffee from Central America and Colombia, and generally tight supply of arabica beans on the worldwide coffee market."
Since February, Folgers has raised the price of its 13 ounce can of coffee four times. Total increases amount to $1.10 -- or more than 48 percent.
The company also raised the price of Folgers Instant Coffee by 1.25 cents per ounce, taking the list price up to $3.96 for an 8-ounce size.
Folgers Singles, however, will remain unchanged at this time due as it has different blends and processing methods, the company said.
